name: scrumux
//name: TODO(publish): registry availability is User's call at publish time (Phase 6). The bin name is `scrumux` regardless.
description: A governance harness for AI coding agents: it installs into a code repository and makes the record — not the chat log, not the agent's recollection — the thing the next session works from.
//files: Allowlist, not a denylist: governance journals, tests and logs can never ship by accident. DERIVED, NOT GUESSED — every entry is a path the CLI reads from its own CODE ROOT: `.deploy-claude/` is the payload (bin points into its dist/, which is what makes codeRoot resolve to the package root) and `tools/grammars/` is the thirteen wasm blobs `graph code build` parses with. It carried five `agents/lib/*.py` and `tools/wall-shim.sh.in` until the bash retirement took both. Anything a published install is missing from this list is not a soft failure — a deploy from it lands a target that verify then calls broken.

scripts.//test: --coverage is not optional: the thresholds in vitest.config.ts are declared CI-FATAL, and a gate that only runs when someone remembers the flag is not a gate. It ran without it until Phase 1d.
scripts.//test:ts-only: The Windows lane. The file list is DERIVED from the tree by tools/ci/posix-partition.mjs, never hand-written, so a new test file is classified the moment it lands rather than the next time somebody remembers an exclude list. No --coverage on purpose: the thresholds in vitest.config.ts are measured against the WHOLE suite, so a subset graded against them fails for arithmetic rather than for coverage.
scripts.//smoke: The end-to-end claim, driven as a process against a real git repo: the built CLI, a deploy, an envelope, a journal write re-read for CR bytes, and two wall bundles fed a hook payload. Needs `npm run build` first. It is the only proof that survives having no shell at all.

//dependencies: web-tree-sitter is pinned EXACT, not caret-ranged, and it is the only entry that is: it is the parse engine behind `graph code build`, its ABI has to match the thirteen grammar .wasm blobs committed under tools/grammars/ (twelve languages plus the tsx dialect) (see the README there), and a silent minor bump is exactly the grammar-version skew a parity migration exists to prevent. IT IS A RUNTIME DEPENDENCY, moved out of devDependencies on User's ruling (2026-09-03): the reader/builder split is about the TARGET, which answers every graph query from the on-disk index with no parser at all — it was never about the INSTALL, and `harness deploy` builds that index from the harness it runs out of. As a devDependency, an `npm i -g` install had no runtime at all: deploy reported code-graph-built=false and every `graph code` query in the target answered 'no index'. The bundle still loads it by COMPUTED path (src/nouns/graph/code-build.ts) so esbuild cannot inline the parser into the payload that ships into governed repos.
